# `Stack`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Stacking progress: per-frame counters from the frame producer and function-state updates.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ; both producer shapes OBSERVED (2026-10-12) |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, NotifyStackState @0x197be0, ExtStackState @0x198840, StackFunc @0x19c3c0 (64-bit build); wire shapes OBSERVED (2026-10-12) |

Two producers share Event Stack; select by members. (1) Frame producer stack-frame notifier: always writes state, frame_type, stacked_frame, dropped_frame, total_frame, error, lapse_ms and code (error/code even when code is 0, so they do not signal failure), plus file_name for a non-empty name; on the 64-bit build it is sent only as frame_complete, once per accepted frame, by the live-stack worker (both direct callers pass a null file name); no producer of a custom start or fail was found, and stack failures surface through the function producer (READ for absence; INFERRED for the alternative path). The 32-bit callers were not decoded. Neither the S nor the function fail-only rule applies to it. (2) Function producer (stack-state detail): Function-state family (F): state is always written; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms when the timer is started or the state is terminal; code and error at fail even when the stored code is 0 (cancel omits them); route optional. A null or nameless detail sends nothing, and non-working notifications can be suppressed while the function cache still changes, so a receiver cannot rely on seeing every transition. Its ordinary branch adds frame_errcode, stacked/dropped counts and annotation/scene flags without frame_type or total_frame; other branches add mosaic, video, photometry and output members. The 32-bit build lacks the wide-mosaic, scene_shooting, auto_exp_us and video file_saved branches. Cadence follows frame rate. OBSERVED (2026-10-12, firmware not matched to 9.31): during a stored plan, one Stack pair per exposure cycle about 0.1 ms apart, one of each producer shape. Channels: imager 4700 and auxiliary 4702 (forwarded to 4700). No reply-before-event order is established: the RPC reply that starts the worker and the worker's events can arrive in either order. No fixed cadence. deepstack_finish is an upload-record field, not a Stack member.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"Stack"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Function producer: idle, working, complete, fail, cancel. Frame producer (stack-frame notifier): frame_complete only on the 64-bit build, once per accepted frame; it does not end the operation. start is listed by the app but no firmware producer was found (READ, absence); kept so clients accept it. No custom fail producer exists. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`, `start`, `frame_complete`. [READ; working and frame_complete OBSERVED (2026-10-12)] |
| `stage` | string | if non-empty stage string held | - | Only when a non-empty stage string is held. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if function producer: timer started or terminal; frame producer: always | - | Milliseconds. Function producer: function-state timer rule. Frame producer: always written from a supplied value, distinct from the function timer. [READ; both shapes OBSERVED (2026-10-12)] |
| `code` | integer | if function producer at fail; frame producer always | - | Function producer: at fail, even if 0. Frame producer: always written, including 0, and does not by itself signal failure. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if function producer at fail; frame producer always | - | Message for code. The frame producer always writes the lookup string, even for code 0. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | if optional; absent is a legitimate branch | - | Function-tree ancestry (for example View, Stack) built at send time. May be absent; not an address. [READ] |
| `frame_type` | string | if frame producer (stack-frame notifier), always | - | Frame-type name from the legacy frame-type table. [READ; OBSERVED (2026-10-12)] |
| `stacked_frame` | integer | if frame producer always; function producer ordinary branch | - | Accepted (stacked) frame count. [READ; OBSERVED (2026-10-12)] |
| `dropped_frame` | integer | if frame producer always; function producer ordinary branch | - | Discarded frame count. [READ; OBSERVED (2026-10-12)] |
| `total_frame` | integer | if frame producer (stack-frame notifier), always | - | Planned total (legacy). [READ; OBSERVED (2026-10-12)] |
| `file_name` | string | if frame producer, name argument non-empty | - | Name argument. Both 64-bit direct callers pass a null name, so it is not sent from them (READ). [READ] |
| `frame_errcode` | integer | if function producer, branch-dependent | - | Last frame-processing error, separate from the operation code; 0 observed. [READ; OBSERVED (2026-10-12)] |
| `can_annotate` | boolean | if function producer, non-mosaic branch | - | Annotation possible. [READ; OBSERVED (2026-10-12)] |
| `scene_shooting` | boolean | if function producer, 64-bit build | - | Scene-capture state. 64-bit build only. [READ; OBSERVED (2026-10-12)] |
| `cont_capt_frame` | integer | if function producer, capture type 1 | - | Continuous-capture frame count. [READ] |
| `progress` | integer | if function producer, wide mosaic | - | Wide-mosaic progress. 64-bit build only. [READ] |
| `stitch_progress` | integer | if function producer, wide mosaic | - | Wide-mosaic stitch progress. 64-bit build only. [READ] |
| `part_complete` | boolean | if function producer, wide mosaic | - | Wide-mosaic partial completion. 64-bit build only. [READ] |
| `ra_dec` | array<number> | if function producer, wide mosaic | - | Mosaic coordinate pair. 64-bit build only; units not stated here. Range: at least 2 item(s). [READ] |
| `jpg_name` | string | if function producer, saved name non-empty | - | Relative name of the saved large JPEG. [READ] |
| `auto_exp_us` | integer | if function producer, auto exposure enabled with a positive exposure | - | Auto-exposure value, microseconds. 64-bit build only. [READ] |
| `file_saved` | boolean | if function producer, capture type 5 video or star-trail video | - | Video output saved. 64-bit build only. [READ] |
| `csv_saved` | boolean | if function producer, photometry capture type 2 | - | Photometry CSV saved. [READ] |
| `angle` | number | if function producer, capture type 2 with a valid (non-sentinel) angle | - | Angle; degrees INFERRED. [READ] |
| `output_file` | object | if function producer, buffer populated | - | Current output-file buffer, `{path, files}` with one file entry, set after a stacked result is saved. Not a scalar filename. [READ] |
| `output_file.path` | string | yes | - | Output directory, relative to the storage root, without a trailing slash. [READ] |
| `output_file.files` | array<object> | yes | - | One object for the saved file; the builder pushes a single entry (no loop). Range: at least 1 item(s). [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].name` | string | yes | - | File path relative to the storage root. [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].date` | string | yes | - | Image date from the image metadata. [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].thn` | string | yes | - | Thumbnail name. [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].type` | integer | yes | - | Album file-type code [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, function-working - Function producer (shape OBSERVED 2026-10-12; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"Stack","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","lapse_ms":912345,"frame_errcode":0,"stacked_frame":42,"dropped_frame":3,"can_annotate":true,"scene_shooting":false,"route":["Stack"]}
```

Event, frame-complete - Frame producer (shape OBSERVED 2026-10-12; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"Stack","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"frame_complete","frame_type":"light","stacked_frame":42,"dropped_frame":3,"total_frame":45,"error":"no error","lapse_ms":9400,"code":0}
```
